The Nifty 50 closed at 25,030.35, up 2.01% on the day and 8.58% over the last five sessions, while Bank Nifty rose 2.27% to 59,086, also up more than 8% weekly. The rally was broad‑based: 216 stocks advanced versus 277 declines in the Nifty 500, giving a breadth score of 67.3 (labelled “HEALTHY”). Advances were well above the 20‑day moving average (71.2% of stocks) and the market stayed above key support levels (Nifty S1 24,602, pivot 24,816, R1 25,244).  

Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) added INR 13,749.82 crore today, extending an eight‑day buying streak, while Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) sold INR 5,968.70 crore, marking a six‑day net outflow. The options market shows a put‑call ratio (PCR) of 1.65 for Nifty, indicating more put (bearish) contracts than calls, and the “max pain” point sits at 24,700, near the lower end of the expected range (24,720‑25,340). Bank Nifty’s PCR is 1.24, with max pain at 57,200, suggesting modest bearish bias.  

Watch the 24,602 S1 level and the 25,816 pivot on Nifty; a break below S1 could test the 23,999 200‑day moving average. For Bank Nifty, the 57,909 S1 and 58,498 pivot are key. Keep an eye on USD‑INR at 93.89 (down 0.66%) and global cues such as Brent crude at $97.66, which may influence sentiment in the next session.
